products.description:
Description:

Experience a complete skin transformation with the DERMAFIRM Peptology Booster Ampoule Set. This comprehensive collection features three high-performance 15ml ampoules from the specialized Peptology range, powered by advanced peptide technology. To achieve the maximum glowing skin effect, we recommend a targeted routine: use the Niacinamide Vita C+ Ampoule in the morning for radiance, and the Retinoid Ampoule at night for deep pore care. Always layer the PDRN Ampoule on top of the others to seal in the benefits and amplify your skin's natural glow. Together, they provide a holistic solution for radiant, firm, and youthful-looking skin.

The Set Includes:

1. Peptology Boosting Ampoule Retinoid (Pore & Wrinkle Care) Achieve flawless, tender skin with this powerful blend of 4th-generation retinoid and ultra-pure peptides. Designed to enhance pore firmness and prevent wrinkles, it actively smooths fine lines for a refined texture. Visible Results: After just 3 days, pore volume is reduced by 34%. Continued use over 28 days results in a 73% reduction in visible makeup clogging within pores.

2. Peptology Boosting Ampoule Niacinamide Vita C+ (Brightening & Glow) Restore your skin's natural radiance with a potent combination of high-concentration Vitamin C, Niacinamide, and peptides. This formula effectively brightens skin tone and boosts your natural glow, keeping skin translucent and vibrant. Visible Results: After 3 days, melanin is significantly reduced by 11%. After 28 days, experience a 16% reduction in dark spots, pigmentation, and discoloration.

3. Peptology Boosting Ampoule PDRN (Repair & Firming) An all-in-one solution featuring upgraded PDRN-4D and high-purity peptides. This ampoule actively repairs skin compromised by environmental factors and UV exposure, restoring elasticity while providing a visible lifting effect. Its superior formulation absorbs 29% better than standard PDRN, penetrating up to 30 layers of the skin. Visible Results: After 3 days of use, see a 19% improvement in deep and fine frown lines.
